implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.__init__(self, size=15) creates a 15x15 grid; GUI calculates board_px using self.board.size (15).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Two players alternate placing black and white stones
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.current_player toggles between Board.BLACK and Board.WHITE in place_stone; GUI reads board.current_player for turn display.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Win detection for five stones in a row (horizontal, vertical, both diagonals)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.check_win iterates over directions [(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,-1)] and returns True when a line length >= WIN_COUNT (5).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Graphical interface showing the board and stones
implemented_requirements.evidence: gui.py defines GomokuGUI which draws the grid, stones, labels, and updates on each move using Tkinter Canvas.
GomokuGUI.draw_board draws an orange oval around each cell in board.winning_line after a win.
GomokuGUI.reset_game clears the board, move history, and redraws the empty board.
GomokuGUI.undo removes the last move from move_history, clears the cell, restores current_player, and redraws.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect draw when board is full
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_full checks every cell; GUI calls it after each move and sets a draw status.

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete Gomoku game on a 15x15 board with alternating black/white turns, win detection in all required directions, a functional Tkinter GUI, and supporting controls (new game, undo, draw detection). The code is self‑contained and appears ready to run, so the submission meets all core requirements.
